b: I’m slowly recovering my older sales figures. One thing that is standing out is, if the ads by themselves don’t manage to illicit engagement, then ads might not save them. I am a lettering artist, and I draw some of my ads in poster style. They do well for drawing engagement.

Before I launch my ads, I post it and give it a day or two to find an organic audience through shares and comments. I do this mainly to give meta some data on what kind of people engage with this content.

It’s obviously terrible out there. And a lot of targetting is still off the mark by a lot. My speculation is: meta is trying to force all our campaigns into AI for training. And we’re facing massive sales crashes.
